headline: Quantum Control, Entanglement, and Agentic Physics
summary: Today's research highlights major strides in quantum information theory, hybrid quantum-mechanical sensing, and AI-driven control systems for experimental physics. From rigorous mathematical equivalences in entanglement theory to physical multi-mode mechanical entanglement and autonomous spectrometer tuning, these papers bridge foundational physics with advanced computational methods.

themes.title: Quantum Information & Cryptography
themes.body: Theoretical breakthroughs exploring entanglement measures, uniform meta-complexity of pseudorandom states, and convex-majorization algorithms for secure quantum communication channels.

themes.title: Mechanical & Molecular Quantum Systems
themes.body: Deterministic generation of multipartite entanglement in acoustic phonon modes, quantum-enhanced mechanical sensing, and hyperpolarization-enabled molecular amplification.

themes.title: Agentic AI in Experimental Physics
themes.body: Deployment of customized LLM agent scaffolding to perform closed-loop experimental research, achieving precise hardware control and high-accuracy model fitting across physical tasks.

connections.body: Both works utilize superconducting transmon qubits and optimal control techniques to manipulate and entangle phonon modes in acoustic resonators.
